name: Villalba del Alcor (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and red with a broad blue stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villalba del Alcor (a cross of Calatrava, a tree and a key on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Villalba del Alcor; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villalba del Alcor arms — cross of Calatrava, tree and key on blue
